objective: Provide a provisional, dependency-aware execution route for the proposed F22-C01..C08 remediation set without certifying audit claims or changing AFOL plans/specs.
non_goals: No product, AFOL lifecycle, spec, roadmap, dependency, release, or runtime changes.
No claim that the attachment's static findings reproduce on current dev.
No F-22 closure, version change, install, deployment, commit, or push.

facts.fact: The active F-22 parent already covers fail-closed lifecycle, mutation/update/bootstrap/governance integrity, strict readers, JSON envelopes, and cross-process identifiers; it requires independently reviewable and reversible phases.
State DB v1 materializes workbench sessions, task rows, source hashes, and evidence only; broader materialization is explicitly State DB v2/future.
F-22 excludes reopening final F-04, F-08, F-09, F-18, and F-20 delivery records.
The attachment proposes C01..C08 and its own dependency graph, but it is static untrusted evidence and not a current-runtime certification.

facts.evidence: git show --stat 90cc8b4; git show --stat 26103e7; git show --stat ccb3d48
facts.fact: Registry/router, workbench lifecycle, governance, file mutation, update/bootstrap, session locks, generated manifests, and their tests were changed together in the committed F-22 work; these are coupled integration surfaces.
Historical final F-22 evidence reports 1062 passing tests plus lint, typecheck, manifest/template, and informative security gates. The report limits that proof to its evidence timestamp.

Release automation exposes validate:release, clean-checkout smoke, provenance, project-benchmark, and release security gates. CI is Ubuntu-only and installs pinned Gitleaks and OSV Scanner before validate:release.
The repository has a mutation-safety test file but no package script that establishes a mutation-testing runner or threshold.
Current governed session T-01 is in progress and is limited to baselining and validating audit claims; T-02 creates child specs and executable slices after that evidence exists.

assumptions.assumption: The attachment's individual defects have not yet been independently reproduced against HEAD.
assumptions.impact: Treat every candidate defect as a test hypothesis; a failing proof is required before a builder changes a handler.

assumptions.assumption: A trustworthy launcher/capability issuer is not yet specified in the approved F-22 parent spec.

assumptions.assumption: C04 State DB v2, the broad C06 families, and much of C07 are intended scope expansions rather than already-approved F-22 child work.
assumptions.impact: Do not create those child specs or make them release blockers until the parent/roadmap decision records the scope change.

review_gates: Before builders: independent source/runtime evidence must classify each attachment claim as reproduced, rejected, or insufficient.
Before each commit/push: critic confirms scope, regression tests, generated artifacts, and no overlap with an unresolved slice.
Before C08: a large read-only council reviews cumulative diff, evidence ledgers, benchmark/mutation/security evidence, release provenance, and unresolved exceptions.
commit_policy: Commit and push only an accepted, independently reviewed slice to dev; do not mix workbench planning artifacts with product remediation commits.
Do not commit generated manifest/template/benchmark changes separately from the public contract change that requires them.
Keep C02B+C03 cross-surface edits reviewable but do not claim either finalized until their combined lifecycle gate passes.
stop_conditions: Stop C01 after the tests if the trusted launcher/capability model is undefined; obtain the explicit authority decision before issuing credentials.
Stop C04 until State DB v2 is approved against the AGENTS.md future boundary and a migration/rollback policy exists.
Stop any C03 work that reopens F-18 command-error delivery records; route it to a new approved feature/spec instead.
Stop C06 unless a named F-22 acceptance failure proves the narrow exception; otherwise route it to its owning feature.
Stop C07 implementation when no measured regression or cross-platform runner exists.
Stop release closure for any failed, absent, stale, or non-independent evidence; historic evidence does not authorize later changes.
